Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and swelling in the right knee. The
mechanism of injury and the force involved are conisstent with the knee complaints described. Over the course of 17 visits, the
patient received conservative management including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and anti-inflammatory
medication. Treatment followed a typiacl progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and function
returned. Examination revealed some findings that support the presence of a soft-tissue injury, including localized tenderness and
limited flexion, while other orthopedic and neurovascular tests were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the
same body region is known. Billing records show the same service was entered twice for one date of service; the provider has
acknowlegded that the second entry was a duplicate and should not have been charged.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
